files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, MapView, List, ListRow, Action, ask } from 'design';
  import NavigationArrow from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/NavigationArrow';
</script>

<Section title="The evening" kicker="Brasa Verlo · 41 Quillon Street">
  <MapView
    places={[
      { label: 'Brasa Verlo', sublabel: '41 Quillon Street' },
      { label: 'Tessaly Garage', sublabel: 'Parking, 3-min walk' }
    ]}
    height={200}
  />
  <List>
    <ListRow index={1} label="Meet at the bar" sub="Drinks while everyone arrives" trailing="7:15 pm" />
    <ListRow index={2} label="Seated at the corner table" sub="Bread and starters to share" trailing="7:30 pm" current />
    <ListRow index={3} label="Mains from the grill" sub="Set menu, one vegetarian" trailing="8:15 pm" />
    <ListRow index={4} label="Dessert and coffee" sub="Table is yours until 10:00 pm" trailing="9:30 pm" />
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label="Directions"
      sublabel="Parking is a 3-min walk"
      icon={NavigationArrow}
      onclick={() => ask('Directions to Brasa Verlo, 41 Quillon Street, and parking at Tessaly Garage', 'Directions')}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>
